item.title: How MCP authorization works and what it leaves to you
item.description: MCP authorization is OAuth 2.1 applied to an MCP server. As of the 2026-07-28 specification, a protected server acts as a resource server: the client sends a token on every HTTP request, the server checks that the token was issued for it, and it must not accept or forward any other token.
